Our product lines include Point of Care, Immunoassays, Molecular Diagnostics and Animal Health.

[ACON's Story][27]

### Our Brands

#### Blood Glucose Meter Systems

Carefully designed for accuracy and reliability, the *On Call*^{®} Blood Glucose Meter Family has
helped millions of patients worldwide effectively manage their glucose levels.

[View Product Line][28]
[Mission POCT]

Our product offering includes a variety of urine reagent test strips, urine analyzers and handheld
devices for the measurement of cholesterol, coagulation and hemoglobin. 

[View Product Line][29]

Reliable qualitative screening for Pregnancy, Cancer Markers and Infectious Disease including our
SARS-CoV-2 (COVID-19) antibody test.

Rapid Antigen Test is the first in this family of lateral flow testing products.

[View Product][32]
[Mission POCT]

Rapid chromatographic immunoassays for the qualitative detection of human chorionic gonadotropin
(hCG) in urine. 

[View Product Line][33]

This tried-and-true immunoblot assay tests for 30 allergens on one strip.

[View Product Line][34]

Nucleic Acid Extraction System and PCR quantitative test kits for HBV, HCV, HPV 16/18, HPV
Genotyping, TB and HLA-B27.

[View Product Line][35]
[CentriVet Logo]

#### Animal Health

Our product offering includes a dual Ketone/Glucose meter, as well as urine reagent test strips.

[View Product Line][36]

## Your partner at
## the point-of-care

#### What we do

As a leading provider of point-of-care diagnostic solutions, we enable healthcare practitioners
across clinical settings and geographies to improve patient outcomes and clinical workflows.

[Patient and Doctor consultation]

### 01

#### Primary Care

When your clinic runs effectively, you have the freedom to provide the best care for your patients.
HemoCue’s point-of-care testing systems enable quick and accurate results so that treatment
decisions can be made with your patient still in the room.

#### Hospital Care

## Featured products

## VITROS^{™} Systems

VITROS^{™} systems enable fast, accurate and reliable results to help labs of every size achieve
operational and cost-efficiency objectives – today and into the future.

[ Learn more ][138]
[VITROS™ Systems]

## SOFIA^{™} Platform

Our SOFIA^{™} 2 Analyzer, the next generation in benchtop diagnostic testing, takes rapid testing to
the next level. Learn about our testing solutions with SOFIA.

[ Learn more ][139]
[SOFIA™ Platform]

## ORTHO^{™} Workstation Immunohematology Analyzer

QuidelOrtho's ORTHO^{™} Workstation is a scalable semi-automated immunohematology solution built
around proven column agglutination technology.

[ Learn more ][140]
[ORTHO™ Workstation Immunohematology Analyzer]

## ORTHO OPTIX^{™} Reader

When linked to the ORTHO^{™} Workstation, the ORTHO OPTIX™ Reader is a complete semi-automated
immunohematology testing solution for transfusion labs.

[ Learn more ][141]
[ORTHO OPTIX™ Reader - Semi-Automated Blood Bank Analyzer]

## LYRA^{™} Assays

Optimize your lab's workflow with QuidelOrtho LYRA^{™} real-time PCR assays, an open platform
solution for high-quality molecular testing.

[ Learn more ][142]
[LYRA™ Assays]

## QUICKVUE^{™} Rapid Lateral-Flow Tests

QUICKVUE^{™} rapid lateral-flow tests produce accurate results in minutes, allowing for faster
diagnoses, better-informed treatments and improved patient outcomes.

[ Learn more ][143]
[QUICKVUE™ Rapid Lateral-Flow Tests]

## TRIAGE^{™} System

QUIDEL^{™} TRIAGE^{™} System provides a reliable solution at the point-of-care for quick and easy
lab quality diagnostic results for a variety of immunoassays.

[ Learn more ][144]
[Triage® System]

## ORTHO VISION^{™} Swift Automated Immunohematology System

For dependably accurate and secure results, ORTHO VISION™ Swift and ORTHO VISION Swift Max analyzers
provide enhanced processing power, responsiveness and data security.

[ Learn more ][145]
[ORTHO VISION™ Swift Automated Immunohematology System]

## NULEXA^{™} System

The NULEXA^{™} System is an ultra-rapid real-time PCR molecular testing system that is designed to
deliver highly sensitive, multiplex testing for influenza A/B and COVID-19 directly from a swab
sample, in ten minutes or less.

[ Learn more ][146]
[NULEXA<sup>™</sup> System]

## Featured products

## VITROS^{™} Systems

VITROS^{™} systems enable fast, accurate and reliable results to help labs of every size achieve
operational and cost-efficiency objectives – today and into the future.

[ Learn more ][138]
[VITROS™ Systems]

## SOFIA^{™} Platform

Our SOFIA^{™} 2 Analyzer, the next generation in benchtop diagnostic testing, takes rapid testing to
the next level. Learn about our testing solutions with SOFIA.

[ Learn more ][139]
[SOFIA™ Platform]

## ORTHO^{™} Workstation Immunohematology Analyzer

QuidelOrtho's ORTHO^{™} Workstation is a scalable semi-automated immunohematology solution built
around proven column agglutination technology.

[ Learn more ][140]
[ORTHO™ Workstation Immunohematology Analyzer]

## ORTHO OPTIX^{™} Reader

When linked to the ORTHO^{™} Workstation, the ORTHO OPTIX™ Reader is a complete semi-automated
immunohematology testing solution for transfusion labs.

[ Learn more ][141]
[ORTHO OPTIX™ Reader - Semi-Automated Blood Bank Analyzer]

## LYRA^{™} Assays

Optimize your lab's workflow with QuidelOrtho LYRA^{™} real-time PCR assays, an open platform
solution for high-quality molecular testing.

[ Learn more ][142]
[LYRA™ Assays]

## QUICKVUE^{™} Rapid Lateral-Flow Tests

QUICKVUE^{™} rapid lateral-flow tests produce accurate results in minutes, allowing for faster
diagnoses, better-informed treatments and improved patient outcomes.

[ Learn more ][143]
[QUICKVUE™ Rapid Lateral-Flow Tests]

## TRIAGE^{™} System

QUIDEL^{™} TRIAGE^{™} System provides a reliable solution at the point-of-care for quick and easy
lab quality diagnostic results for a variety of immunoassays.

[ Learn more ][144]
[Triage® System]

## ORTHO VISION^{™} Swift Automated Immunohematology System

For dependably accurate and secure results, ORTHO VISION™ Swift and ORTHO VISION Swift Max analyzers
provide enhanced processing power, responsiveness and data security.

[ Learn more ][145]
[ORTHO VISION™ Swift Automated Immunohematology System]

## NULEXA^{™} System

The NULEXA^{™} System is an ultra-rapid real-time PCR molecular testing system that is designed to
deliver highly sensitive, multiplex testing for influenza A/B and COVID-19 directly from a swab
sample, in ten minutes or less.

[ Learn more ][146]
[NULEXA<sup>™</sup> System]

## We are Roche

We combine life-changing diagnostics and medicines to take on the toughest healthcare challenges,
those that place the greatest strain on patients, families, communities, and health systems. 

Guided by the experiences of patients, we are determined to prevent, stop and cure diseases so
people can live healthier, longer lives.

  Our Operations
  
  Our extensive onshore and offshore operations produce a full range of valuable gas products. We
  maintain a constant focus on operational excellence, asset reliability and HSE performance.
  
  Our Operations>Gas Processing
  
  Operating at the heart of the UAE’s hydrocarbon value chain, we receive feed gas from ADNOC’s
  onshore and offshore production operations, and produce a mixture of sales gas, NGLs, condensate
  and sulfur to serve our downstream customers.
  
  Our Operations>LNG Operations
  
  Our liquefaction facilities supply LNG from gas produced in ADNOC’s offshore operations for export
  to utilities and industrial customers around the globe.
  
  Our Operations>Pipeline Network
  
  Our extensive 3,260km gas pipeline network enables delivery of sales gas to customers across Abu
  Dhabi, Dubai and the Northern Emirates, meeting ~60 % of UAE’s gas requirements
  
  Our Operations>Industrial Gases
  
  We are one of the UAE’s major suppliers of industrial gases, primarily nitrogen and oxygen.
  
  Our Operations>Other Products
  
  We produce several other associated products, primarily for use in the chemicals sector by
  customers both in the UAE and overseas.

  We apply a determined focus on sustainability across our business.
  
  Sustainability>Environment
  
  We have developed a robust road map of projects to accelerate significant advances in our
  environmental performance that delivered a 10% reduction in our GHG emissions (2021 vs 2018
  baseline).
  
  Sustainability>Health & Safety
  
  We maintain an unwavering focus on health and safety and are continually striving to drive our
  first quartile performance towards our ultimate goal of ensuring ‘100% HSE’ - keeping our
  employees, communities, the environment and assets safe from harm.
  
  Sustainability>UAE Growth
  
  We act as a powerful catalyst to driving the UAE’s economic development and diversification,
  providing energy and other gas products vital to UAE industry, and ensuring a strong in-country
  value contribution from our operations.

  In alignment with ADNOC Group, we manage our operations to make a positive contribution to the
  development of our society and the communities in which we operate.

  The first LNG export facility in the MENA region to run on clean power. Producing 9.6 million tons
  of LNG per year providing access to reliable and affordable energy.

  ADNOC Gas continues to invest to increase gas processing capacity and further integrate its
  onshore and offshore facilities. A key component of this program has been the Integrated Gas
  Development project and its subsequent extension phases.

# ADNOC Gas

## One of the World’s Largest Integrated Gas Companies

ADNOC Gas is a large-scale, integrated gas processing company and a subsidiary of ADNOC, one of the
world's largest integrated energy companies.

As a leading global gas player with access to capacity of around 10 billion standard cubic feet of
gas per day (bscfd), we serve a wide range of domestic and international customers with an expanding
portfolio of products. We supply around 60% of the UAE’s gas needs and export natural gas and
related products to a diverse customer base in over 20 countries.

## Our Company

ADNOC Gas is a world-class integrated gas company operating an unmatched asset base that supplies
around 60% of the UAE's natural gas requirements and serves customers in more than 20 countries.

[Our Company][69]


### Our Operations

Our extensive onshore and offshore operations produce a full range of valuable gas products. We
maintain a constant focus on operational excellence, asset reliability and HSE performance.

[Explore][70]

### Sustainability

We apply a determined focus on sustainability across our business.

[Explore][71]

### Our Projects

We continue to invest in and develop our gas and LNG processing, transmission and export
infrastructure, expanding capacity and connectivity, and driving efficiency and sustainability.

[Explore][72]

### Innovation

Innovation and technology are core to our operations. We are transforming our business, deploying
cutting-edge artificial intelligence (AI) technologies and digital solutions to manage our
operations more efficiently, safely and sustainably.

[Explore][73]

### Marketing

We currently export LNG and other gas products to more than 20 countries and are strategically
situated to serve the primary international growth markets in Asia.

[Explore][74]

## Investor Relations

On 13 March 2023, ADNOC Gas successfully commenced trading on ADX. Read more about our financial
profile as we capitalize on growing demand for natural gas and the UAE’s significant investments in
the energy sector.

## In Clinical
## Diagnosis

Founded in 1983, All Eights has established long term partnerships with our local clinical
laboratory community and notable manufacturers.

### All Eights Group

##### Reliable Distributor for Medical, Analytical and Laboratory Products

All Eights Group is a company specialising in the distribution of products for Clinical Diagnostic,
Analytical Science and Scientific Equipment
 
Companies looking to expand their business outside their domestic market face many challenges. Our
role is to be their best possible partner, based on our expertise in our market as well as the
network and reach of our existing customer base.
 
With a strong track record, we have established ourselves as a reliable partner.

customers with different needs, we serve our clinical customers through our core company, All

All Eights Group is a company specialising in the distribution of products for Clinical Diagnostic,
Analytical Science and Scientific Equipment
 
Companies looking to expand their business outside their domestic market face many challenges. Our
role is to be their best possible partner, based on our expertise in our market as well as the

## Frequently Asked Questions

[ What types of diagnostic products does Astam Diagnostics manufacture?
][94]

Astam Diagnostics manufactures a wide range of In-Vitro Diagnostic (IVD) kits and medical devices,
including Biochemistry Reagents, Rapid Diagnostic Test Kits (Immunochromatography), Immunology kits,
and advanced laboratory consumables for hospitals and diagnostic centers.

 

[ Does Astam Diagnostics provide OEM and private label manufacturing services?
][95]

They offer end-to-end OEM and private label manufacturing services for IVD kits and medical devices,
custom-tailored to the formulations, packaging, branding, and regulatory compliance standards of
global healthcare brands.

 

[ What regulatory and quality certifications does your manufacturing facility hold?
][96]

The manufacturing plant operates under stringent international quality protocols. Astam Diagnostics
is ISO 13485:2016 certified, with products manufactured in compliance with CDSCO regulations and CE
certification standards.

 

[ How can global distributors or laboratories request a bulk supply or custom quote?
][97]

For wholesale distribution, laboratory tenders, or bulk supply requirements, interested parties can
fill out the corporate enquiry form on the website or email the B2B procurement cell directly. The
company provides scalable logistics for both domestic (Pan-India) and international shipments.

[ Do you ensure batch-to-batch consistency for your biochemistry reagents and rapid kits?
][98]

The in-house R&D facility and quality assurance teams perform rigorous analytical and clinical
evaluations on every batch, guaranteeing exceptional sensitivity, specificity, and long-term
stability across all diagnostic products.

[ Where can individuals or small clinics buy retail quantities of your products online?
][99]

While the main website handles bulk corporate contracts, a dedicated e-commerce storefront is
available for retail orders. Small clinics, laboratories, and individual clients can purchase
selected medical devices at shop.astamdiagno.com.

  speed, and reliability in PCR applications. Its advanced features, including rapid thermal
  cycling, sophisticated program management, and exceptional temperature control, make it a
  cornerstone for any lab committed to achieving consistent and reproducible results.

  $201.00 – $245.00Price range: $201.00 through $245.00
  Avam® NAsafe™ is an advanced nucleic acid transport medium designed to collect, inactivate, and
  preserve microbial and human nucleic acids with unparalleled efficiency. Ideal for molecular
  diagnostics, genetics research, and sequencing applications, NAsafe™ ensures sample integrity from
  collection to analysis.

  $117.00 – $1,136.00Price range: $117.00 through $1,136.00

## Featured Products
* ### [AutEx™ 96 Nucleic Acid Extractor][146]
  
  The Avam® AutEx™ 96 is a revolutionary tool for molecular biology, offering unmatched precision,
  speed, and reliability in PCR applications. Its advanced features, including rapid thermal
  cycling, sophisticated program management, and exceptional temperature control, make it a
  cornerstone for any lab committed to achieving consistent and reproducible results.
  [Select options][147] This product has multiple variants. The options may be chosen on the product
  page [Show more][148]
* ### [Avam® NAsafe™ Nucleic Acid Molecular Transport Medium][149]
  
  $201.00 – $245.00Price range: $201.00 through $245.00
  Avam® NAsafe™ is an advanced nucleic acid transport medium designed to collect, inactivate, and
  preserve microbial and human nucleic acids with unparalleled efficiency. Ideal for molecular
  diagnostics, genetics research, and sequencing applications, NAsafe™ ensures sample integrity from
  collection to analysis.
  [Select options][150] This product has multiple variants. The options may be chosen on the product
  page [Show more][151]
* ### [DNA VersaKit™][152]
  
  $117.00 – $1,136.00Price range: $117.00 through $1,136.00
  Facilitate streamlined DNA purification with the DNA VersaKit™, compatible with Avam® AutEx™
  platform for automated processing of up to 96 samples, offering rapid and reliable extraction of
  high-quality DNA from various sample types.
  [Select options][153] This product has multiple variants. The options may be chosen on the product
  page [Show more][154]

## ESCHWEILER – automatic analysing systems

For clinics, medical practices and laboratories ESCHWEILER offers a product line of reliable, fully
automatic analysers for the determination of blood gases, electrolytes and t-hemoglobin.

The Company was founded in 1951 by Wilhelm Eschweiler. In the same year the worldwide first
commercially manufactured apparatus – made by ESCHWEILER – for measuring oxygen pressure was
introduced to the market: The very first beginning of blood gas analysis at all ([historic
facts][56]).

In close cooperation with scientific and clinical research departments the ESCHWEILER company is
continuously engaged in decisive developments in the field of blood gas- and electrolyte analysis.
Improvement of measuring methods and automatisation always are the priorities in order to offer
reliable and easy to operate analysers for clinics, medical practices and laboratories.

For more than 60 years ESCHWEILER analysers are in use worldwide. Quality products – made in
Germany.

## ESCHWEILER – automatic analysing systems

For clinics, medical practices and laboratories ESCHWEILER offers a product line of reliable, fully
automatic analysers for the determination of blood gases, electrolytes and t-hemoglobin.

The Company was founded in 1951 by Wilhelm Eschweiler. In the same year the worldwide first
commercially manufactured apparatus – made by ESCHWEILER – for measuring oxygen pressure was
introduced to the market: The very first beginning of blood gas analysis at all ([historic
facts][56]).

In close cooperation with scientific and clinical research departments the ESCHWEILER company is
continuously engaged in decisive developments in the field of blood gas- and electrolyte analysis.
Improvement of measuring methods and automatisation always are the priorities in order to offer
reliable and easy to operate analysers for clinics, medical practices and laboratories.

For more than 60 years ESCHWEILER analysers are in use worldwide. Quality products – made in
Germany.

## Why Choose Us?

At Ganesh diagnostic, we offer multiple services to our patients at affordable prices because your
health is our first priority. We have a skillful and talented team associated with us to deliver the
best to our clients.

A free 24/7 ambulance service is also available to avoid havoc in emergency situations. We have
updated technologies to generate **100% accurate reports** for every test and check-up. We are an
organization that has been trusted by 30,000+ doctors. Active in the business for quite some time.

Back in 2001, famed radiologist Dr. Ravin Sharma laid the foundations of this organization after his
father, Ganesh Chand Sharma. From humble beginnings, our growth and expansion have become a
significant ride of many things. Today, we are considered one of the **best diagnostic centres and
[pathology][116] labs across Delhi**, robust problem solvers, and highly efficient in all areas.

## About Ganesh Diagnostic

**Ganesh Diagnostic** and Imaging Centre Pvt. Ltd. has been active in the **Diagnostic and
Pathology** Service sector for quite some time, Back in 2001, Famed Radiologist Dr. Ravin Sharma
laid the foundation of this organization with his father, Renowned Radiologist, Dr. Ganesh Chandra
Sharma. From humble beginnings, our growth and expansion have become a significant ride of many
things. Now, we are seen as one of the **Best Diagnostic and Pathology** services providers around
**Delhi**, resolving issues and problems in a robust and highly effective way all across the
board. At our Delhi-based diagnostic centres, we provide an array of services including *[blood
tests][117], [X-rays][118], [ultrasounds][119], [CT scans][120], [MRI scans][121]*, etc. We also
offer *[home sample collection in Delhi][122]* and help identify diseases early so that treatment as
soon as possible.

## Why Choose Us?

At Ganesh diagnostic, we offer multiple services to our patients at affordable prices because your
health is our first priority. We have a skillful and talented team associated with us to deliver the
best to our clients.

A free 24/7 ambulance service is also available to avoid havoc in emergency situations. We have
updated technologies to generate **100% accurate reports** for every test and check-up. We are an
organization that has been trusted by 30,000+ doctors. Active in the business for quite some time.

Back in 2001, famed radiologist Dr. Ravin Sharma laid the foundations of this organization after his
father, Ganesh Chand Sharma. From humble beginnings, our growth and expansion have become a
significant ride of many things. Today, we are considered one of the **best diagnostic centres and
[pathology][116] labs across Delhi**, robust problem solvers, and highly efficient in all areas.

## About Ganesh Diagnostic

**Ganesh Diagnostic** and Imaging Centre Pvt. Ltd. has been active in the **Diagnostic and
Pathology** Service sector for quite some time, Back in 2001, Famed Radiologist Dr. Ravin Sharma
laid the foundation of this organization with his father, Renowned Radiologist, Dr. Ganesh Chandra
Sharma. From humble beginnings, our growth and expansion have become a significant ride of many
things. Now, we are seen as one of the **Best Diagnostic and Pathology** services providers around
**Delhi**, resolving issues and problems in a robust and highly effective way all across the
board. At our Delhi-based diagnostic centres, we provide an array of services including *[blood
tests][117], [X-rays][118], [ultrasounds][119], [CT scans][120], [MRI scans][121]*, etc. We also
offer *[home sample collection in Delhi][122]* and help identify diseases early so that treatment as
soon as possible.

##  


Igloo Reader Pro is a certified digital diagnostic device designed for pharmacies, clinics, and
health-related businesses.

Measure key biomarkers directly on-site and deliver standardized, quantitative results within 5-15
minutes.

CE Marked | ISO 13485 Manufacturing | UKCA Compliant

business.

## How does Igloo Reader Pro work? 

Igloo Reader Pro analyzes rapid diagnostic tests using digital quantitative technology. The device
eliminates subjective visual interpretation and delivers consistent, standardized results within
minutes.
* No laboratory setup required.
* No complex preparation.
* Minimal staff training needed.
* Designed for seamless integration into pharmacies, clinics, and point-of-care environments.

Request a free personal demonstration - we will show you how Igloo Reader Pro can work in your
pharmacy or clinic.

Email *

# Thank you !

Our team will message you back as soon as possible.

Expand your service portfolio with high-demand health indicators such as:
* Iron deficiency (Ferritin) 
* Vitamin D deficiency
* Thyroid function (TSH) and other hormones
* Diabetes monitoring (HbA1c and blood glucose)
* Cardiovascular risk markers (Lp(a), ApoB, lipid panel, and hs-CRP)

and many more!

Offer modern preventive health services directly at your point-of-care business with the Igloo
Reader Pro.

## Have a prescription but not sure which tests to add?

Patients can search the catalog directly, or share prescription details during checkout so the JCRL

[Add tests from catalog][52][Email prescription][53]
[Patient handing prescription to a diagnostic care professional]

## Home collection without losing laboratory control.

JCRL's process makes collection easier for patients while protecting the integrity of the sample
from pickup to testing.

1

#### Sample collected by trained staff

A qualified phlebotomist visits your home.

2

#### Transported in designed packets

Secure logistics protect sample integrity.

3

#### Tested at NABL central lab

Quality control monitoring at every stage.

4

#### Report delivered online

Secure, fast, and reviewed by pathologists.

[Book Home Collection][54]
[JCRL home collection visit with sample preparation]

Technology Matters

Advanced laboratory platforms support biochemistry, immunoassay, hematology, and molecular
workflows.

## Why patients, families, and partners trust JCRL

The value of a diagnostics network lies in consistency: trained handling, disciplined quality
systems, responsive service, and results that can be relied upon.

#### NABL-aligned quality discipline

Quality systems, review protocols, and laboratory control help maintain confidence in every report.

#### Careful sample movement

Transport and handling matter because sample integrity affects the final result.

#### Secure report access

Patients can retrieve reports digitally while still receiving support when clarification is needed.

#### Experienced laboratory oversight

Scientific supervision and professional review remain central to the reporting process.

## Specialised departments within the JCRL laboratory system

A serious diagnostics network depends on focused departments, appropriate analytical methods, and
trained scientific teams working within clear laboratory boundaries.

[Explore Our Quality ][55]

### Molecular Diagnostics

Supports high-sensitivity work such as infectious marker analysis and specialised molecular
investigations where routine methods are not sufficient.

RT-PCRViral Load HCV/HBVHLA-B27

### Biochemistry

Handles routine and specialised chemistry testing for organ function, metabolic balance, and
broad-profile screening needs.

Kidney ProfileLiver FunctionElectrolytes

### Immunology

Supports hormone testing, vitamin studies, tumor markers, and serology through platform-specific
analytical methods.

Thyroid PanelVitamin DTumor Markers

### Histopathology

Provides tissue-based diagnostic support where microscopic examination is essential for deeper
clinical assessment.

BiopsiesCytologyIHC

### Hematology

Supports blood counts, coagulation review, and advanced blood-cell analysis for routine and
specialised diagnostic needs.

CBC AnalysisCoagulation ProfileHbA1c

### Microbiology

Supports culture-driven and infection-focused testing where organism detection and sensitivity
patterns are clinically important.

Urine CultureBlood CultureFungal Smear

## Support designed around three kinds of trust

JCRL serves patients, clinicians, and partner centres with different needs, but the same expectation
of reliability.

1

### For patients

Clear booking pathways, home collection support, digital report access, and assistance when test
names or preparation steps are unclear.

Verified against JCRL service scope

2

### For doctors

A broad test menu, structured laboratory workflows, and a diagnostics partner that values scientific
clarity and responsiveness.

Verified against JCRL service scope

3

### For partners

Operational support, logistics, consumables, training, and a laboratory backbone designed for
network reliability.

Verified against JCRL service scope

Leadership behind JCRL

## An organisation earns credibility through people, standards, and continuity.

JCRL's direction is shaped by leadership that balances laboratory discipline, operational
seriousness, and a sustained commitment to patient trust.

careful, and professionally accountable.”

## Have a prescription but not sure which tests to add?

Patients can search the catalog directly, or share prescription details during checkout so the JCRL
team can confirm the right test names before collection.

[Add tests from catalog][52][Email prescription][53]
[Patient handing prescription to a diagnostic care professional]

## Home collection without losing laboratory control.

JCRL's process makes collection easier for patients while protecting the integrity of the sample
from pickup to testing.

1

#### Sample collected by trained staff

A qualified phlebotomist visits your home.

2

#### Transported in designed packets

Secure logistics protect sample integrity.

3

#### Tested at NABL central lab

Quality control monitoring at every stage.

4

#### Report delivered online

Secure, fast, and reviewed by pathologists.

[Book Home Collection][54]
[JCRL home collection visit with sample preparation]

Technology Matters

Advanced laboratory platforms support biochemistry, immunoassay, hematology, and molecular
workflows.

## Why patients, families, and partners trust JCRL

The value of a diagnostics network lies in consistency: trained handling, disciplined quality
systems, responsive service, and results that can be relied upon.

#### NABL-aligned quality discipline

Quality systems, review protocols, and laboratory control help maintain confidence in every report.

#### Careful sample movement

Transport and handling matter because sample integrity affects the final result.

#### Secure report access

Patients can retrieve reports digitally while still receiving support when clarification is needed.

#### Experienced laboratory oversight

Scientific supervision and professional review remain central to the reporting process.

## Specialised departments within the JCRL laboratory system

A serious diagnostics network depends on focused departments, appropriate analytical methods, and
trained scientific teams working within clear laboratory boundaries.

[Explore Our Quality ][55]

### Molecular Diagnostics

Supports high-sensitivity work such as infectious marker analysis and specialised molecular
investigations where routine methods are not sufficient.

RT-PCRViral Load HCV/HBVHLA-B27

### Biochemistry

Handles routine and specialised chemistry testing for organ function, metabolic balance, and
broad-profile screening needs.

Kidney ProfileLiver FunctionElectrolytes

### Immunology

Supports hormone testing, vitamin studies, tumor markers, and serology through platform-specific
analytical methods.

Thyroid PanelVitamin DTumor Markers

### Histopathology

Provides tissue-based diagnostic support where microscopic examination is essential for deeper
clinical assessment.

BiopsiesCytologyIHC

### Hematology

Supports blood counts, coagulation review, and advanced blood-cell analysis for routine and
specialised diagnostic needs.

CBC AnalysisCoagulation ProfileHbA1c

### Microbiology

Supports culture-driven and infection-focused testing where organism detection and sensitivity
patterns are clinically important.

Urine CultureBlood CultureFungal Smear

## Support designed around three kinds of trust

JCRL serves patients, clinicians, and partner centres with different needs, but the same expectation
of reliability.

1

### For patients

Clear booking pathways, home collection support, digital report access, and assistance when test
names or preparation steps are unclear.

Verified against JCRL service scope

2

### For doctors

A broad test menu, structured laboratory workflows, and a diagnostics partner that values scientific
clarity and responsiveness.

Verified against JCRL service scope

3

### For partners

Operational support, logistics, consumables, training, and a laboratory backbone designed for
network reliability.

Verified against JCRL service scope

Leadership behind JCRL

## An organisation earns credibility through people, standards, and continuity.

JCRL's direction is shaped by leadership that balances laboratory discipline, operational
seriousness, and a sustained commitment to patient trust.

[Dr. Simpi Rani, Director Laboratory, JCRL Diagnostics]

“Every diagnostic result carries a duty of care. Our responsibility is to make that process clear,
careful, and professionally accountable.”

### Dr. Simpi Rani

Director Laboratory, JCRL Diagnostics

[Mr. Sanjeev Mishra, Managing Director, JCRL Diagnostics]

“A diagnostics network becomes dependable when service, logistics, reporting, and operational
discipline improve together over time.”

### Mr. Sanjeev Mishra

Managing Director, JCRL Diagnostics

# Laboratory Equipment Manufacturer for Research & Testing

Labtron Equipment is a leading manufacturer of innovative Laboratory Equipment and Analytical
Equipment for all kinds of laboratory applications. Our laboratory equipment are compact,
energy-efficient, and durable, featuring built-in safety for versatile use. We offer a range of
laboratory equipment and analytical instruments including centrifuges, chillers, incubators, mixers,
freeze dryers, shakers, petroleum testing, water testing, airborne particle counters, biochemistry
analyzers, test chambers, automated stainers, furnaces, GC-MS, HPLC, spectrophotometers, and more,
ensuring comprehensive support for all your laboratory needs. We make sure every product meets our
high standards by carefully checking them with strict quality control measures.

We are ISO 9001:2015 Certified company and all our products comply with stringent International
Standards such as Certificate of Compliance (2014/35/EU Low Voltage Directive & 2014/32/EU Measuring
Instruments Directive), Good Manufacturing Practice (GMP) System, ISO 13485:2016, ISO 9001:2015, EC
Declaration of Conformity (In Vitro Diagnostic Medical Devices Directive 98/79/EC) and Certificate
of Conformity (European Pressure Equipment Directive 2014/68/EU).

Home

Who we are

Engineering the 

extraordinary

# Groundbreaking healthcare technology solutions for the most complex and challenging conditions.
# Inspiring hope and new possibility in people all over the world.

[ See how ][175]

HEALTHCARE TECHNOLOGY

## Medtronic Engineering & Innovation Center (MEIC)

MEIC symbolizes Medtronic’s commitment to R&D and innovation in healthcare. It serves as a
technology hub to deliver on our mission.

[ Learn more ][176]

PUT PATIENTS FIRST

## See the signs, seize your destiny.

The #TimetoDecideDestiny campaign aims to create awareness about the importance of stroke prevention
and timely treatment by reaching the nearest stroke-ready hospital.

[ Learn more ][177]

PATIENT EQUITY

## Decode your rhythm

Learn about bradycardia and leadless pacemaker therapy. Explore causes, symptoms, and care tips.
#DecodeYourRhythm

[ Learn more ][178]

HealthCare Technology

## Medtronic Global Diabetes Capability Center

Engineering technology that simplifies diabetes care

[ Learn more ][179]

## Creating connections to optimize healthcare systems

Innovation without collaboration isn't enough. We work closely with healthcare professionals to
introduce new therapies and optimize treatments.

[ Read more ][180]

Our impact

## Impact with purpose

#### With 95,000-plus people in over 150 countries, we see extraordinary possibilities to further
#### increase our positive impact in the world. We are committed to accelerating access to
#### healthcare technology, advancing inclusion, diversity & equity, and protecting our planet.

[ Learn more ][181]

## Join the team that powers the extraordinary

Want to do work that has the potential to make the world a better place? Then join us. Speed and
decisiveness run through our DNA. Diverse perspectives inspire bold solutions to the world’s most
complex and challenging conditions. Our careers change lives.

# Groundbreaking healthcare technology solutions for the most complex and challenging conditions.
# Inspiring hope and new possibility in people all over the world.

[ See how ][175]

HEALTHCARE TECHNOLOGY

## Medtronic Engineering & Innovation Center (MEIC)

MEIC symbolizes Medtronic’s commitment to R&D and innovation in healthcare. It serves as a
technology hub to deliver on our mission.

[ Learn more ][176]

PUT PATIENTS FIRST

## See the signs, seize your destiny.

The #TimetoDecideDestiny campaign aims to create awareness about the importance of stroke prevention
and timely treatment by reaching the nearest stroke-ready hospital.

[ Learn more ][177]

PATIENT EQUITY

## Decode your rhythm

Learn about bradycardia and leadless pacemaker therapy. Explore causes, symptoms, and care tips.
#DecodeYourRhythm

# Welcome to Microbe Notes

[Microbe Notes Cover]

**Microbe Notes **is an educational platform covering study notes on microbiology, bacteriology,
virology, parasitology, mycology, immunology, molecular biology, biochemistry, computational
biology, laboratory, health, medical, and related branches of the life sciences. It was established
on 2018-07-20. It provides structured study notes and concept-focused explanations designed to
support undergraduate and graduate students, with particular usefulness for exam preparation in
A-level Biology, AP Biology, IB Biology, and university-level biology and microbiology programs
(BSc, MSc, MPhil, and PhD).

# Welcome to Microbe Notes

[Microbe Notes Cover]

**Microbe Notes **is an educational platform covering study notes on microbiology, bacteriology,
virology, parasitology, mycology, immunology, molecular biology, biochemistry, computational
biology, laboratory, health, medical, and related branches of the life sciences. It was established
on 2018-07-20. It provides structured study notes and concept-focused explanations designed to
support undergraduate and graduate students, with particular usefulness for exam preparation in
A-level Biology, AP Biology, IB Biology, and university-level biology and microbiology programs
(BSc, MSc, MPhil, and PhD).

# Complete Diagnostic Supplies for Modern Laboratory Needs

Murex Diagnostics is a trusted medical equipment distributor providing high-quality diagnostic
solutions to laboratories across the Philippines. The company offers a wide range of products, from
analyzers to testing kits, supported by responsive service, technical expertise, and dependable
after-sales support to help laboratories operate efficiently and deliver accurate results.

[Get in Touch][23]
[Afias 6 front]

## Diagnostic Equipment Provider for High-Performing Laboratories

As a leading laboratory equipment supplier in the Philippines, Murex Diagnostics delivers a wide
range of diagnostic solutions designed for accuracy, efficiency, and speed. These specialized
solutions include clinical chemistry, electrolyte analysis, and HbA1c testing, helping laboratories
expand their testing capabilities and reduce the need for external referrals.

The right equipment enables clinics to deliver faster results, improve patient experience, and
support better clinical decisions. Murex Diagnostics helps laboratories scale their operations while
maintaining a commitment to accessible, community-focused diagnostics.

[the Murex team]
[AMS SAT 450][AMS SAT 450]

### Clinical Chemistry

Clinical chemistry systems support the measurement of key biochemical markers, such as glucose,
enzymes, and lipids. Murex Diagnostics supplies clinical chemistry equipment that delivers accurate
results for both routine and specialized diagnostics.

[EC 90 with cartridge][EC 90 with cartridge]

### Electrolyte Analysers

Electrolyte analyzers provide fast and precise measurement of sodium, potassium, and chloride
levels. Murex Diagnostics offers a range of compact and automated systems, giving laboratories the
flexibility to choose solutions that match their workload, space, and testing requirements.

[Greencare A1c][Greencare A1c]

### HbA1c Analyzers

HbA1c analyzers are designed for reliable diabetes monitoring through accurate long-term glucose
assessment. As a medical and lab supplier for clinics of all sizes, Murex Diagnostics offers a range
of compact and automated systems that prioritize accuracy and convenience, helping laboratories
improve turnaround times and deliver dependable results for patient management.

We’re inspired by positive patient outcomes. Over more than 80 years we’ve delivered
industry-leading technology, expert service, and specialized education to make a world of difference
in the lives of care providers and their patients.

[Neuro Solutions][103]

We put clinicians first in the consideration and development of each solution we provide. We deliver
innovative and trusted solutions to screen, diagnose, and treat disorders affecting the brain and
neural pathways.

We are dedicated to providing unparalleled service to ensure a seamless experience, helping our
partners to deliver the highest standard of care and achieve the best possible patient outcomes.

possible results. Natus Academies provide expert knowledge, clinical expertise and advanced
education – whatever your role, wherever you work.

### Featured Products - See our favorites

[[Clinical nucleic acid extraction, in tune with your lab’s rhythm]][108]

##### [Clinical nucleic acid extraction, in tune with your lab’s rhythm][109]

Introducing QIAsymphony Connect – coming soon – the next generation of automated IVD nucleic acid
extraction. Built on the trusted QIAsymphony SP platform, it combines proven performance with
enhanced traceability, high nucleic acid yields and connectivity for modern clinical labs.
[See QIAsymphony Connect][110]
[[Streamline your clinical PCR workflows with QIAcuityDx]][111]

##### [Streamline your clinical PCR workflows with QIAcuityDx][112]

QIAcuityDx is a fully automated digital PCR system tailored for IVD applications. It enhances
diagnostic precision and operational efficiency by reducing hands-on time and ensuring accurate
detection and quantification of important genetic variations.
[Explore QIAcuityDx][113]
[[Discover the eco-friendlier alternative to our most popular nucleic acid extraction kits]][114]

##### [Discover the eco-friendlier alternative to our most popular nucleic acid extraction
##### kits][115]

Make your lab more sustainable with our QIAwave kits, now both in 50 and 250 sample sizes. The
QIAwave kits use less plastic and cardboard compared to our standard kits with reusable waste tubes
made from 100% recycled plastic.
[See for yourself][116]
[[Meet the NEW TissueLyser III]][117]

##### [Meet the NEW TissueLyser III][118]

Ensure successful downstream DNA and RNA analysis from the start by effectively lysing your
challenging samples with the TissueLyser III.  Get one for your lab today.
[View instrument][119]
[[QIAseq xHYB Viral and Bacterial Panels: High-quality targeted viral and bacterial NGS]][120]

##### [QIAseq xHYB Viral and Bacterial Panels: High-quality targeted viral and bacterial NGS][121]

Harness the power of hybrid capture technology for high-sensitivity detection and sequencing of
respiratory viruses, sexually transmitted pathogens, bacterial AMR genes and adventitious agents.
[Product details][122]
[[Fast-track your RNA-seq with QIAseq FastSelect RNA Library Kits]][123]

##### [Fast-track your RNA-seq with QIAseq FastSelect RNA Library Kits][124]

Go from sample to libraries in <5 hours with a fast and convenient solution that incorporates rRNA
removal, library prep and data analysis.
[Go to product][125]
[[Study the spread of mpox with the QIAstat-Dx Viral Vesicular Panel]][126]

##### [Study the spread of mpox with the QIAstat-Dx Viral Vesicular Panel][127]

Enhance your research and surveillance efforts of the mpox virus with our QIAstat-Dx Viral Vesicular
Panel. With seven viral targets included, you can easily differentiate nucleic acids from multiple
viral pathogens.
[Technical overview][128]
[[Work smarter with the QIAxcel Connect gel electrophoresis system]][129]

##### [Work smarter with the QIAxcel Connect gel electrophoresis system][130]

Ready-to-use, easy-to-replace gel cartridges. High resolution, high sensitivity. Process up to 96
samples in a single run. All this power and convenience – in a single gel electrophoresis
instrument.
[Product info][131]
[[QIAcuity dPCR System: Fast, accessible and reliable digital PCR]][132]

##### [QIAcuity dPCR System: Fast, accessible and reliable digital PCR][133]

Three things every laboratory deserves. And it is qPCR-like but only better. So, treat your research
to a fully integrated and scalable nanoplate-based digital PCR system, delivering absolute answers
from your samples in two hours.
[Discover more][134]

### Featured Products - See our favorites

[[Clinical nucleic acid extraction, in tune with your lab’s rhythm]][108]

##### [Clinical nucleic acid extraction, in tune with your lab’s rhythm][109]

Introducing QIAsymphony Connect – coming soon – the next generation of automated IVD nucleic acid
extraction. Built on the trusted QIAsymphony SP platform, it combines proven performance with
enhanced traceability, high nucleic acid yields and connectivity for modern clinical labs.
[See QIAsymphony Connect][110]
[[Streamline your clinical PCR workflows with QIAcuityDx]][111]

##### [Streamline your clinical PCR workflows with QIAcuityDx][112]

QIAcuityDx is a fully automated digital PCR system tailored for IVD applications. It enhances
diagnostic precision and operational efficiency by reducing hands-on time and ensuring accurate
detection and quantification of important genetic variations.
[Explore QIAcuityDx][113]
[[Discover the eco-friendlier alternative to our most popular nucleic acid extraction kits]][114]

##### [Discover the eco-friendlier alternative to our most popular nucleic acid extraction
##### kits][115]

Make your lab more sustainable with our QIAwave kits, now both in 50 and 250 sample sizes. The
QIAwave kits use less plastic and cardboard compared to our standard kits with reusable waste tubes
made from 100% recycled plastic.
[See for yourself][116]
[[Meet the NEW TissueLyser III]][117]

##### [Meet the NEW TissueLyser III][118]

Ensure successful downstream DNA and RNA analysis from the start by effectively lysing your
challenging samples with the TissueLyser III.  Get one for your lab today.
[View instrument][119]
[[QIAseq xHYB Viral and Bacterial Panels: High-quality targeted viral and bacterial NGS]][120]

##### [QIAseq xHYB Viral and Bacterial Panels: High-quality targeted viral and bacterial NGS][121]

Harness the power of hybrid capture technology for high-sensitivity detection and sequencing of
respiratory viruses, sexually transmitted pathogens, bacterial AMR genes and adventitious agents.
[Product details][122]
[[Fast-track your RNA-seq with QIAseq FastSelect RNA Library Kits]][123]

##### [Fast-track your RNA-seq with QIAseq FastSelect RNA Library Kits][124]

Go from sample to libraries in <5 hours with a fast and convenient solution that incorporates rRNA
removal, library prep and data analysis.
[Go to product][125]
[[Study the spread of mpox with the QIAstat-Dx Viral Vesicular Panel]][126]

##### [Study the spread of mpox with the QIAstat-Dx Viral Vesicular Panel][127]

Enhance your research and surveillance efforts of the mpox virus with our QIAstat-Dx Viral Vesicular
Panel. With seven viral targets included, you can easily differentiate nucleic acids from multiple
viral pathogens.
[Technical overview][128]
[[Work smarter with the QIAxcel Connect gel electrophoresis system]][129]

##### [Work smarter with the QIAxcel Connect gel electrophoresis system][130]

Ready-to-use, easy-to-replace gel cartridges. High resolution, high sensitivity. Process up to 96
samples in a single run. All this power and convenience – in a single gel electrophoresis
instrument.
[Product info][131]
[[QIAcuity dPCR System: Fast, accessible and reliable digital PCR]][132]

##### [QIAcuity dPCR System: Fast, accessible and reliable digital PCR][133]

Three things every laboratory deserves. And it is qPCR-like but only better. So, treat your research
to a fully integrated and scalable nanoplate-based digital PCR system, delivering absolute answers
from your samples in two hours.
[Discover more][134]

## Product highlights

### **Safe. Gentle. Precise. **

The new Safety-Multifly^{®} PRO combines maximum user safety with a high level of patient comfort.
The semi-automatic safety mechanism activates the needle in the vein, reducing the risk of needle
stick injuries and blood splatter after blood collection, while the ultra-thin-walled needle
supports a high level of patient comfort thanks to reduced insertion force and gentle blood flow.

[
Experience more
][158]
01 / 23

## Business areas

To meet your requirements in medicine and research, we offer a broad product portfolio in the fields
of pre-analysis, life science, laboratory automation and sample transport. The needs of the user are
always at the centre of our solutions.

[ICN Life-Science 1024x1024]

### Life Science

In the areas of liquid handling, cell culture, molecular biology, sample handling and microbiology,
we offer customised solutions of the highest purity and consistent quality. These are specially
designed to ensure reproducibility in analysis. Our products are certified and fulfil the strictest
requirements for research.

[
Life Science
][159]
[ICN Praaeanalytik 1024x1024]

### Preanalytics

For clinics, medical practices and laboratories, we offer a comprehensive range of sample collection
systems and accessories for blood, urine, faeces and saliva. We attach great importance to safety
and efficiency.

[
Preanalytics
][160]
[ICN Probentransport 1024x1024]

### Sample transport

As an essential part of the pre-analytical workflow, our sample transport products ensure the safety
and integrity of your diagnostic samples. We understand the need to safely ship potentially
infectious samples in accordance with clear ADR/RID and IATA dangerous goods regulations to ensure
the protection of all parties involved and to achieve optimal analytical results.

[
Sample transport
][161]
[ICN Labor-Automation 1024x1024]

### Laboratory automation

With our automation solutions, we make laboratory processes in pre-analytics faster, more precise
and more economical. Our many years of experience as a partner in laboratory automation make us a
reliable partner for your needs.

[
Laboratory automation

We believe that tailored innovation and collaborative partnership are the keys to the best possible
healthcare for all. Therefore, we consistently place the needs of medical and research professionals
at the center of our work, just as much as the perspective of patients.

In our pursuit of optimal solutions, we are in close dialogue worldwide with our customers and are
genuinely interested in your needs. For we are convinced that successful partnership leads to mutual
and sustainable growth.

## Product highlights

### **Safe. Gentle. Precise. **

The new Safety-Multifly^{®} PRO combines maximum user safety with a high level of patient comfort.
The semi-automatic safety mechanism activates the needle in the vein, reducing the risk of needle
stick injuries and blood splatter after blood collection, while the ultra-thin-walled needle
supports a high level of patient comfort thanks to reduced insertion force and gentle blood flow.

[
Experience more
][158]
01 / 23

## Business areas

To meet your requirements in medicine and research, we offer a broad product portfolio in the fields
of pre-analysis, life science, laboratory automation and sample transport. The needs of the user are
always at the centre of our solutions.

[ICN Life-Science 1024x1024]

### Life Science

In the areas of liquid handling, cell culture, molecular biology, sample handling and microbiology,
we offer customised solutions of the highest purity and consistent quality. These are specially
designed to ensure reproducibility in analysis. Our products are certified and fulfil the strictest
requirements for research.

[
Life Science
][159]
[ICN Praaeanalytik 1024x1024]

### Preanalytics

For clinics, medical practices and laboratories, we offer a comprehensive range of sample collection
systems and accessories for blood, urine, faeces and saliva. We attach great importance to safety
and efficiency.

[
Preanalytics
][160]
[ICN Probentransport 1024x1024]

### Sample transport

As an essential part of the pre-analytical workflow, our sample transport products ensure the safety
and integrity of your diagnostic samples. We understand the need to safely ship potentially
infectious samples in accordance with clear ADR/RID and IATA dangerous goods regulations to ensure
the protection of all parties involved and to achieve optimal analytical results.

[
Sample transport
][161]
[ICN Labor-Automation 1024x1024]

### Laboratory automation

With our automation solutions, we make laboratory processes in pre-analytics faster, more precise
and more economical. Our many years of experience as a partner in laboratory automation make us a
reliable partner for your needs.

[
Laboratory automation
][162]

## Partners for medicine and research

We believe that tailored innovation and collaborative partnership are the keys to the best possible
healthcare for all. Therefore, we consistently place the needs of medical and research professionals
at the center of our work, just as much as the perspective of patients.

In our pursuit of optimal solutions, we are in close dialogue worldwide with our customers and are
genuinely interested in your needs. For we are convinced that successful partnership leads to mutual
and sustainable growth.

## The Sensa Core Difference

#### We strive to improve care and outcomes through inspired and world-leading healthcare solutions.
* [
  [Advanced Research & Development]
  
  ### Advanced Research & Development
  
  Sensa Core believes in the product, quality, and reliability for the benefit of human life. We
  develop the products in the most innovative way to assist the clinicians, health care
  professionals & laboratories to improve the product’s usability and reliability. We design &
  develop innovative medical devices that possess the ultra-modern technology that enables an
  individual to maintain pace with the advanced methodologies & technologies. Our research team is
  comprised of personnel that is certified with many years of experience in all phases and processes
  for design and development of IVD products.
  
  ][73]
* [
  [Quality & regulatory]
  
  ### Quality &
  ### Regulatory
  
  We are committed to develop and manufacture products that meet the global standards of statutory
  and regulatory requirements. In the healthcare industry, we aspire to meet stringent standards and
  intend to improve customer satisfaction by manufacturing enhanced quality products. We have a team
  of experts who work on the continual improvement of QMS, enhancing manufacturing processes by
  imparting periodical training to employees to meet all possible international standards in
  manufacturing facilities.
  
  ][74]
* [
  [Manufacturing & Operations]
  
  ### Manufacturing & Operations
  
  Sensa Core is concerned with Operations and manufacturing to a broader aspect. We manufacture,
  assemble, and test a wide range of products in our facilities in India. These manufacturing
  facilities are managed by our highly sophisticated manufacturing staff with the state of the art
  technology and ultra-modern plant that designed to meet all the international standards of the
  medical devices to become globally competitive across the recognized dimensions of quality, cost,
  delivery, flexibility, product innovation, and customer experience.
  
   
  
  ][75]

## The Sensa Core Difference

#### We strive to improve care and outcomes through inspired and world-leading healthcare solutions.
* [
  [Advanced Research & Development]
  
  ### Advanced Research & Development
  
  Sensa Core believes in the product, quality, and reliability for the benefit of human life. We
  develop the products in the most innovative way to assist the clinicians, health care
  professionals & laboratories to improve the product’s usability and reliability. We design &

  comprised of personnel that is certified with many years of experience in all phases and processes
  for design and development of IVD products.

  ### Regulatory
  
  We are committed to develop and manufacture products that meet the global standards of statutory
  and regulatory requirements. In the healthcare industry, we aspire to meet stringent standards and
  intend to improve customer satisfaction by manufacturing enhanced quality products. We have a team
  of experts who work on the continual improvement of QMS, enhancing manufacturing processes by
  imparting periodical training to employees to meet all possible international standards in
  manufacturing facilities.
  
  ][74]

  Sensa Core is concerned with Operations and manufacturing to a broader aspect. We manufacture,

  technology and ultra-modern plant that designed to meet all the international standards of the
  medical devices to become globally competitive across the recognized dimensions of quality, cost,
  delivery, flexibility, product innovation, and customer experience.
